reading: The sketch lays out a "Team members" admin page: a heading and subtext with an "+ Invite" button top right, a filter/search toolbar, a bulk-selection action bar, a full member data table with avatars/roles/status/usage, an open status-filter dropdown menu floating over the table, and a pager at the bottom — all content specified precisely by the typed notes.

Blue, white-text button "+ Invite" placed top right of the header area.
